Name: Colossal Animal Houses
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Do you hoard animals like there's no tomorrow? Do you have way too many animal houses on your farm, taking up precious space? Are you a modder who can't stop modding in animals and frequently runs out of testing room? (No? Just me?) Have I got the mod for you!

This mod adds a new upgrade option to your farm buildings: the Colossal Barn and Coop! Each buildings holds up to 50 (!) animals. The maps are a modified version of bobkalonger's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic Coop and Barn[/url], which has open permissions. The upgrades can be ordered from Robin for:

Colossal Barn - 200,000g, 1000 wood, 850 stone, and 500 hardwood
Colossal Coop - ﻿150,000g, 900 wood, 700 stone, and 300 hardwood.

I know, I know, they're on the pricey side and resource heavy. But you get your money's worth, I promise! Each building comes fully equipped with autofeeders, autograbbers, autopetters, heaters, and incubators! Yes, even an ostrich incubator in the barn, and 3 incubators in the coop. They also use the Deluxe building exteriors so they don't take up any extra room on your farm. They're also fully recolor compatible!

**NOTE: As of 1.2 you can config the upgrades to be from the vanilla deluxe coop or bobkalonger's Giga buildings :)

Enjoy!
